meta.name: fatigue-frequency-manager
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "is my ad fatiguing", "why is CTR dropping at scale", or "should I rotate creative / widen the audience"; reads frequency, CTR and CVR decay against an early-flight baseline and returns Rotate-creative / Widen-audience / Hold triggers with a per-ad-set fatigue read. Not for building the replacement creative — use ad-creative-builder; not for the RQS score or vetoes — use ad-account-auditor. 广告疲劳检测/频次管理/换素材还是扩人群

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测广告疲劳度，判断是否换素材或扩人群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理大量广告组，需要科学判断何时更换素材或调整受众。
copy.tagline_en: Detect ad fatigue and decide whether to rotate creative or widen audience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many ad sets and need data-driven decisions on creative rotation or audience widening.

howto.what: 分析广告组的频次、点击率和转化率趋势，判断是否存在创意疲劳或受众饱和，并给出“换素材”、“扩人群”或“保持”的建议。
howto.when: 当用户询问广告是否疲劳、点击率下降原因，或是否需要换素材/扩人群时触发。需要提供广告组的时间序列数据（频次、点击率、转化率等）。

say.text: 我的广告频次到了6.2，点击率两周内降了一半，是疲劳了吗？
say.note: 技能会分析频次和点击率趋势，判断是否疲劳并给出建议。

say.text: 转化率稳定但点击率持续下滑，该换素材还是扩人群？
say.note: 技能会区分创意疲劳和受众饱和，返回对应触发条件。

say.text: 帮我检查这个广告组的疲劳情况，数据在附件里。
say.note: 技能会读取附件中的时间序列数据，输出诊断结果。

howto.what_en: Analyzes ad set frequency, CTR, and CVR trends to detect creative fatigue or audience saturation, returning a Rotate-creative, Widen-audience, or Hold trigger per ad set.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about ad fatigue, CTR drop, or whether to rotate creative or widen audience. Requires a time-series export of the ad set (frequency, CTR, CVR, etc.).

say_en.text: My ad frequency hit 6.2 and CTR halved in two weeks—is it fatigue?
CVR is stable but CTR keeps sliding—should I rotate creative or widen audience?
Check this ad set for fatigue; data is in the attachment.
say_en.note: The skill reads the attached time-series data and outputs a diagnosis.
